title: RepoTales: The Saga of the Broken Pipeline
synopsis: In the sprawling codebase of the FastAPI realm, a lone backend paladin named Aria stands against the creeping entropy of production outages. When a race condition awakens in the deploy pipeline, she must unite with an unlikely cast of contributors to restore order before the Friday release.

hero.name: Aria Nakamura
hero.catchphrase: If it compiles, it ships. If it ships, it breaks. I fix it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1 — The First Commit
chapters.summary: Aria opens her terminal at dawn. A single commit lands in main, and the saga begins.

panels.scene: A dimly lit office at sunrise. Monitors glow with green terminal output.

bubbles.text: Every saga starts with a single commit pushed at the edge of dawn.

panels.scene: Close on Aria's focused face, lit by monitor glow. Her fingers hover over the keyboard.

bubbles.text: This refactor has been stalling for three sprints. Tonight, it dies.

panels.scene: The terminal prints 'commit 4f7a1c9 — feat: introduce async worker pool'.

chapters.title: Chapter 2 — The Refactor at Midnight
chapters.summary: Kenji and Sora join the fight as the CI turns red. A marathon refactor begins.

panels.scene: Kenji bursts into the room holding a laptop, alarm in his eyes.

bubbles.text: The deploy is red. Forty-two failing jobs. We have twenty minutes.

panels.scene: Extreme close-up on Aria's eye, a single tear of coffee-fueled resolve.

bubbles.text: Then we fix them all. One PR at a time.

panels.scene: Sora appears at the doorway, tablet in hand, glasses reflecting the CI logs.

bubbles.text: I found the flaky test. It's been lying to us for weeks.

chapters.title: Chapter 3 — The Green Pipeline
chapters.summary: The team splits the work. Commit by commit, the red wall turns green.

panels.scene: A war table covered in sticky notes. Three silhouettes lean over a build graph.

bubbles.text: Kenji takes the deploy. Sora takes the tests. I take the worker pool.

panels.scene: Close-up of a terminal scrolling commit after commit, the counter climbing.

bubbles.text: Seventeen commits in one night. My keyboard is smoking.

panels.scene: The CI board flips from red to green, one job at a time, reflected in three pairs of glasses.

bubbles.text: Green. All of it. I don't trust it either.

chapters.title: Chapter 4 — The Calm Before
chapters.summary: The pipeline is green and the team goes home. Something is already wrong in production.

panels.scene: An empty office at night. One monitor still glowing, unattended.

bubbles.text: They shipped at 22:40 and celebrated until midnight. Production did not.

panels.scene: Close on a phone screen lighting up a dark bedroom. Twelve notifications stacked.

bubbles.text: Twelve alerts. At three in the morning.

panels.scene: Aria sits up in the dark, laptop already open, face half-lit by the screen.

bubbles.text: Wake the others. We're going back in.

boss_fight.name: The Production Incident of 3:00 AM
boss_fight.description: A race condition in the async worker pool triggers a cascade of 500s across the entire API. Every monitor in the war room turns red simultaneously.
boss_fight.stakes: If the incident is not resolved before sunrise, the Friday release is cancelled and the team's credibility crumbles.
phases: Phase 1 — The Alert Storm: pager duty explodes as 12 alerts fire in 30 seconds.
Phase 2 — The Silent Log: Aria isolates the failing coroutine, but the stack trace is empty.
Phase 3 — The Fix: Kenji rolls back, Sora adds a regression test, Aria merges the hotfix.
boss_fight.outcome: The pipeline turns green at 4:47 AM. The release ships on time. Aria adds a post-mortem to the repo.

panels.scene: Wide shot of the war room. Red dashboards everywhere. Three engineers frozen at their desks.

bubbles.text: It's everywhere. The API is down.

panels.scene: Close-up of Aria, head in her hands, eyes burning with focus.

bubbles.text: Not tonight. Not on my watch.

panels.scene: The final terminal output: 'deploy succeeded'. Green checkmarks rain down the screen.
